thread:
Maya: UX check — added a Burst confirmation modal to the autoscale flow. Goal: prevent users thinking burst is "free" and show estimated burst cost + SLO risk. mock: https://redwood-internal.mock/s/burst-confirm-modal.png

Phil: nice. can you paste the copy you're thinking for the modal?

Maya: primary copy: "Allow burst capacity for this pool?" body: "Burst temporarily exceeds Max GPUs during spikes. You are billed only for additional GPUs used during bursts. Estimated monthly cost: ~$12. Action: enable burst or cancel."

We also show: SLO impact: "May increase p95 latency — auto-fallback will use smaller model if breached."

Phil: suggestion: show a small breakdown line: Current Max 8 GPUs | Projected peak 12 GPUs | Est. additional cost: $12/month. makes it concrete.

Jorge: infra note: we can compute estimated cost from recent burst frequency sample but it will be a best-effort. mark it as "estimate" and include link to billing docs. also, ensure the modal warns if bursting exceeds pool hard limit.

Leah: accessibility notes: the modal must be focus-trapped and restore focus on close. the confirmation button should be first in the DOM for screen reader users to avoid accidental activation when using enter key. also include aria-describedby linking to the SLO risk line.

Nora: UX nit: label the confirm button "Enable burst" (explicit) and the secondary "Cancel". add a "Remember my choice for this pool" checkbox so admins can persist decisions.

Maya: good call on persistence. if checked we'll store preference per pool-id. will add copy: "Remember this setting for pool 'gpu-prod-2'. You can change later in Pool settings."

Phil: mobile behavior: recommend full-screen modal on small widths and keep the cost breakdown collapsible to reduce vertical space.

Jorge: implementation detail: when the modal opens we must re-check pool constraints in case limits changed. if projected peak > pool hard limit show inline error: "Requested burst (12) exceeds pool max (10). Adjust or contact infra." with role=alert.

Leah: keyboard affordances: bind ESC to close, ensure modal close button is reachable, and announce when the estimate is loading: "Estimating burst cost..." with aria-live polite. also, if estimate fails show fallback copy: "Cost estimate not available. Proceed?"

Maya: copy for the SLO microcopy line: "SLO risk: May increase p95 latency. Auto-fallback to smaller model if breached." short and clear. include a learn more link.

Nora: for the "Remember my choice" checkbox add an icon tooltip explaining scope: "Applies only to this pool and can be overridden by org policy." keeps expectations clear.

Phil: telemetry: emit event autoscale.burstModal.shown and autoscale.burstModal.confirmed with fields pool_id, remembered=true/false, estimate_present=true/false. helps measure friction.

Jorge: agree. also emit autoscale.burstModal.estimate_error when RPC fails. We should debounce estimate calls if user toggles modal quickly.

Leah: last a11y check: modal contrast and focus ring, button spacing (touch target >=44px), and ensure the learn-more link has descriptive text (not just "Learn more"). e.g., "Learn more about burst billing".

Maya: great. next steps: Ill update the mock with the breakdown row, remembered checkbox, and mobile collapse. Phil to add telemetry events; Jorge to gate the estimate call and add error state; Leah to run a quick a11y pass once updated. will post new image.

design-bot: New mock uploaded: https://redwood-internal.mock/s/burst-confirmation-modal-v2.png

Maya: thanks team — will loop back with final copy and a short note for docs.
